context: Two sisters reminisce while looking at old photos
purpose: Teach: 何故か/何となく/あいだ/あれこれ/とらえ/かえって/あて/いかなる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 見て、このアルバム。あなたと私のあいだに座ってるの、お母さんよね。
lines.en: Look at this album. The one sitting between you and me — that's Mom, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft maternal nostalgia, slow gentle pacing, warm.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 本当だ。何となく若く見えるけど、もう四十は過ぎてた頃ね。
lines.en: You're right. She looks somehow young, but she was already past forty here.
lines.style: Aunt's relaxed amused tone, slightly raspy, fond.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あれこれ思い出すと泣きそうになるわ。何故か今日は特に。
lines.en: When I recall all these little things I almost cry. For some reason, today especially.
lines.style: Voice catches gently, wistful trailing emotion.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 泣かないでよ。かえって私まで来ちゃうじゃない。
lines.en: Don't cry. Otherwise it'll get to me too, you know.
lines.style: Teasing warmth half-covering her own welling emotion, half-laughing softly through it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: この瞬間をとらえた写真、お父さんが撮ったのよね。腕、よかったわ。
lines.en: Dad was the one who captured this moment, wasn't he. He had a real eye for it.
lines.style: Quiet admiration, slower reflective delivery, tender.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん。私の記憶なんてあてにならないけど、夏祭りの帰りだった気がする。
lines.en: Yeah. My memory isn't reliable, but I think it was on the way home from the summer festival.
lines.style: Casual, searching her memory aloud, soft chuckle.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いかなる時も家族の写真だけは捨てないでって、お母さん言ってたわよね。
lines.en: No matter what, never throw away the family photos — that's what Mom always said.
lines.style: Gentle solemn recollection, voice steady but tender.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 守ってきてよかった。こうして二人で笑える日が来るんだもの。
lines.en: I'm glad we kept that promise. Days like this, where we can laugh together, do come around.
lines.style: Warm closing tone, smile audible in the voice.
